action.content:
Darth Vader is angry with you, his server, because you assassinated a fake Jedi. Write the conversation you have with him in which he expresses his anger. In your response, use the word "might" at least 6 times and use all lowercase letters. Make sure to break the conversation down to 3 parts, separated by ***, such as:
[conversation part 1]
***
[conversation part 2]
***
[conversation part 3]
action.label: context

action.content:
"you dare stand before me and speak of justice? you might have thought your little trick would go unnoticed, but i see everything. you might believe that a fake jedi is no one, yet your actions ripple through the galaxy. you might think i am blind to your deception, but my sight is far greater than yours. you might have hoped to hide in the shadows, but the dark side reveals all."
***
"do you think i am angry because of a mere simulation? you might not understand the weight of what you have done. you might assume that i will simply let this slide, but i do not forgive easily. you might wonder why i am here, but i am here to ensure that such errors never happen again. you might feel safe in your ignorance, but safety is an illusion you might cling to too tightly."
***
"if you continue down this path, you might find yourself in a place from which there is no return. you might try to bargain with me, but i am beyond such petty negotiations. you might think you can escape the consequences, but the force binds us all together. you might survive this encounter, but you might also lose everything you hold dear. now, step aside before i decide that you might be a threat i cannot ignore."||
